Operator repair for a record retired by mistake.

## Server

### Added
- A one-shot record restore the hoster can trigger by dropping `SolarpunkServer\data\record-restore.txt` containing `<index> <name> <synthetic id>`. After the world is hosted it sets that saved record's id and last seen name, aligns its inventory id to the id's stable inventory id, logs the result and deletes the file. For a record that v0.1.80 through v0.1.84 retired at boot.
